note: Territory dealers (PR #419, DT-24 ... DT-27) and team leads add agents / the main dealer promotes (PR #420, DT-28, DT-29). Written 20-Nov-2026 after both reached staging.

features.feature: Territory dealer: a TIERED dealer holds an exclusive set of pincodes for a yearly fee and earns 20-25% of GoKesari's commission on orders there
Territory rules: one holder per pincode; every approved shop counts; order income stays with the territory dealer; cancelled / refunded goods excluded; paid on the 5th
Territory rating 5-10 (onboarding up to 2.5 + product upload up to 2.5), share 20% + 1% a point, at most 25%, worked out daily
Territory fee: online or recorded offline, 12 months, renewal from 30 days before, lapse, 30-day grace then pincodes released
A team lead adds agents under himself at once (no approval); the main dealer is told; agents still ask
The main dealer promotes an agent who meets the rule (50 activated shops + 3 ready agents); earlier stays an admin override

scenarios.title: Verify the yearly territory fee: online and offline payment, renewal window, lapse and release
scenarios.description: Pay online (sandbox, paid up only on the signed webhook), record offline, renew within 30 days, expire, release after 30 days' grace (dealer, admin).

scenarios.title: Verify the daily territory rating and the 20-25% share
scenarios.description: Rating from onboarding and product-upload points, share table, edges, daily job and Rate now (admin, dealer).

scenarios.title: Verify territory order income: which orders count, refunds, month close, payout and statement
scenarios.description: Orders delivered by shops in the territory while paid up, refunds netted, TERRITORY ledger entry at month close, REVERSAL for late refunds, team commission unchanged (dealer, admin).

scenarios.title: Verify the territoryDealer rule switch, access control and the dealer's territory card
scenarios.description: Nothing changes while the rule is off; who may read / change territories; the territory card on /dealer on desktop and phone.

cases.title: A team lead adds an agent under himself at once, with his own code; the main dealer is told
cases.preconditions: dealer_programme_enabled and the rule dealerTieredCommission ON on staging. A TIERED chain: main dealer M > team lead L1 > agent A1, each with a linked account and the agent agreement accepted. A second TIERED dealer M2 with its own agent A9.
cases.steps:
1. Sign in as team lead L1 and open https://test.gokesari.com/dealer
2. In 'Add an agent to your team' enter a new ID, name and mobile (optional) and add
3. Check L1's team list and the new agent's referral code
4. Sign in as main dealer M: open the notifications and /dealer > team mapping / history
cases.expected: The agent is added at once (no request, no admin approval), placed under L1 with his own referral code. M gets a notice 'L1 (team lead) added <name> (<ID>) to his team as an agent.' and the mapping history shows the change. No commission entry is made for recruiting.
cases.remarks: Needs PR #420 (DT-28 / DT-29, on staging since 20-Nov-2026).

cases.title: A team lead adds agents only, and only under himself
cases.preconditions: dealer_programme_enabled and the rule dealerTieredCommission ON on staging. A TIERED chain: main dealer M > team lead L1 > agent A1, each with a linked account and the agent agreement accepted. A second TIERED dealer M2 with its own agent A9. A second team lead L2 under M.
cases.expected: Step 1 refused (403): 'A team lead adds agents only; the main dealer adds team leads.' Step 2: the agent is placed under L1 (parentId is ignored), never under L2. Never a 4th level.
cases.remarks: Needs PR #420 (DT-28 / DT-29, on staging since 20-Nov-2026).

cases.title: An agent cannot add anyone; he asks for a sub-agent and an admin decides
cases.preconditions: dealer_programme_enabled and the rule dealerTieredCommission ON on staging. A TIERED chain: main dealer M > team lead L1 > agent A1, each with a linked account and the agent agreement accepted. A second TIERED dealer M2 with its own agent A9.
cases.steps:
1. Sign in as agent A1 and open /dealer
2. Look for 'Add an agent to your team'
3. POST /api/dealer/team {action: 'addMember', role: 'AGENT', ...} as A1
4. Request a sub-agent from /dealer
5. As admin, open TIERED > Sub-agent requests
cases.expected: No 'Add an agent' form for an agent; the API refuses (403): 'Only a team lead adds agents; an agent asks for a sub-agent instead.' The request appears under Sub-agent requests and only an admin approves or declines it. Leads no longer appear there (they add directly).
cases.remarks: Needs PR #420 (DT-28 / DT-29, on staging since 20-Nov-2026).

2. Admin sets L1 inactive (or the dealer not approved); L1 tries to add an agent
cases.expected: Step 1 refused with a clear duplicate-ID message; nothing created. Step 2 refused: 'Your place in the team is not active.' / 'Your dealer is not approved at present.'

cases.title: A lead-added agent's code works before his account is linked; his commission waits for the agreement
cases.preconditions: dealer_programme_enabled and the rule dealerTieredCommission ON on staging. A TIERED chain: main dealer M > team lead L1 > agent A1, each with a linked account and the agent agreement accepted. A second TIERED dealer M2 with its own agent A9. New agent A5 just added by L1, account not linked yet.
cases.steps:
1. Register and pay a test shop with A5's referral code (sandbox)
2. Approve the shop; open A5's commission in the ledger
3. Admin > TIERED > Link account for A5; A5 signs in and accepts the agent agreement
4. Re-open the ledger
cases.expected: The shop is attributed to A5 (20%), L1 4%, M 3%. A5's share waits ('agreement not accepted') until he is linked and accepts; then it is released for the next payout. Linking stays an admin action.

cases.title: The main dealer promotes an eligible agent: his recruits move with him and the former lead gets the development bonus
cases.preconditions: dealer_programme_enabled and the rule dealerTieredCommission ON on staging. A TIERED chain: main dealer M > team lead L1 > agent A1, each with a linked account and the agent agreement accepted. A second TIERED dealer M2 with its own agent A9. e2e.title: Territory dealer: territory, fee, rating, order income and payout
e2e.preconditions: Rule territoryDealer switched on for the test on staging; a TIERED test dealer; test shops in the test pincodes; sandbox payments; month close with the developer.
e2e.journey:
1. Admin gives the dealer a territory (exclusive pincodes, yearly fee)
2. Dealer pays the fee online (sandbox) and the territory becomes Active
3. Daily rating; customers order from shops in the territory; one goods refund
4. The dealer's card shows this month's orders and income
5. Month close: TERRITORY entry, one payout on the 5th with 'Territory order income'
6. Rule switched off again
e2e.expected: Pincodes held exclusively; Active only after the webhook; share 20-25% by rating; refunds netted; one payout with the territory line; nothing else changes while the rule is off.
e2e.remarks: Needs PR #419 (territory dealers, on staging since 20-Nov-2026); rule territoryDealer is off on staging until switched on for the test.

e2e.title: Team lead grows his team; the main dealer promotes an agent
e2e.preconditions: A TIERED chain main dealer > team lead > agent with linked accounts; promotion counts arranged with the developer on staging.
e2e.journey:
1. Team lead adds an agent from /dealer; the main dealer is told
2. The new agent signs shops with his own code (sandbox); commission waits until his account is linked and the agreement accepted
3. An agent reaches 50 shops and 3 ready agents
4. The main dealer promotes him from /dealer
5. Month close with >= 100 shops from the new team
e2e.expected: Agent added at once under the lead; 20 / 4 / 3 % on his shops; promotion only when eligible, recruits move with him; former lead's 1% development bonus only in months with >= 100 shops.
e2e.remarks: Needs PR #420 (DT-28 / DT-29, on staging since 20-Nov-2026).
